context: Directions Directions: Mix drops in 1/4 cup of water and sip slowly. Adults and children 12+: 0.50 mL 3-5 times daily. Children under 12: 0.25 mL 3-5 times daily. For acute symptoms, repeat every 15-20 minutes as needed up to 6 doses.
